sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

Warning: This release changes the /v2/users API. Update your integration before you upgrade.

Breaking change: The `name` field splits into two fields, `first_name` and `last_name`. The `name` field is no longer available. Change your requests and your response parsing to use the two new fields.

New feature: The `--incremental` flag is now available. This flag tells sqlpipe to process only the new or changed rows. Use this flag to make repeated runs faster.

Performance: Parquet writes are now 40% faster. sqlpipe gives this result with no change to your configuration.

To upgrade, install v2.0 and test the /v2/users change in a safe environment first.
